rules.statement: Unless the appeals marked P11(a), P11(b) and P11(c) are heard and determined, the 1st Respondent cannot institute proceedings in the Magistrate’s Court to recover the penalties as reflected in the notices marked P10(a), P10(b) and P10(c).
rules.supporting_quote: For the aforesaid reasons I hold: (a) Unless the appeals marked P11(a), P11(b) and P11(c) are heard and determined, the 1st Respondent cannot institute proceedings in the Magistrate’s Court to recover the penalties as reflected in the notices marked P10(a), P10(b) and P10(c).
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 57(1)(b) of the Financial Statute of the Western Province, No.6 of 1990
